user.title: Intelbras AMT 4010
user.description: Local connection to an AMT 4010 on TCP port 9009. The panel is only read until commands are enabled in the options.

data_description.password: 4 or 6 digits. The remote-access password is not accepted by this protocol.

reauth_confirm.title: The panel refused the password
reauth_confirm.description: Type the current master or user password (4 or 6 digits). Polling stopped so a wrong password is not repeated at the panel.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check the IP address, the port and whether another app is connected.
error.not_amt4010: The device answered, but not like an AMT 4010.
error.invalid_password_format: The password must have 4 or 6 digits.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

data_description.enable_commands: Off by default. Turn on only after the partitions have been checked against the keypad.
data_description.partitions: The status reports which partitions are armed, not which exist; this decides when the panel counts as fully armed.
data_description.zones: Empty = the zones with a name programmed in the panel. Or a list such as 1-8, 12.

commands_disabled.message: Arm/disarm is disabled for this panel. Enable it in the integration options.

zones_open.message: The panel refused to arm: zones are open. Nothing changed.

not_partitioned.message: The panel refused: it is not partitioned. Nothing changed.

no_permission.message: The panel refused: this user may not disarm. Nothing changed.

partition_without_zones.message: The panel refused: this partition has no enabled zones. Nothing changed.

rejected.message: The panel refused the command ({code}). Nothing changed.

password_refused.message: The panel refused the stored password. Nothing changed; update the password in the integration.

ambiguous.message: Unknown result: the panel may or may not have applied the command. Do not repeat it; check the keypad first.

not_sent.message: The panel could not be reached; the command was not sent. Nothing changed.

not_read_back.message: The panel accepted the command, but its state could not be read back. Check the keypad.
